设计意图： Mutates parent by replacing rolling mean with rolling median for persistence measurement. Median reduces sensitivity to extreme volume spikes, yielding a more stable and robust signal that improves rank consistency and nonlinear information (targeting weak RankIC and MI) while preserving the core economic mechanism of sustained relative volume smoothing. 📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-(rolling median of <vol_ratio>(volume/EMA) over 60 days)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_median —— 过去 N 天滚动中位数
    ts_median(divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20)), 60)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20))
  3. 3. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 20)
